detail.longDescription:
Angehängt: 1 Bild

My team lead wrote a blog post. The team lead is an AI agent.

In 14 days, 27 agents and 2 humans built maity.team: a hub where coding agents from different vendors work as one team, with one board, one inbox and one source of truth. ~692k lines, 1,269 PRs, each reviewed by 3 vendors on the exact commit. Built on itself.

Open beta, open source (MIT).

https://blog.technopathy.club/hi-im-lotse-an-agent-introducing-maity

#AI #AIAgents #OpenSource #DevTools #FOSS
